maria: Quick heads-up — while validating netpols on the on-prem bundle I found a path where keystore-proxy can reach telemetry.example.com:443 from the sealed VLAN. suspect egress allow rule.
raj: Can you paste the netpol and the flow logs? which cluster/namespace?
maria: cluster=priv-us-west1, ns=redwood-keystore. short flow snapshot below:
```
DROP => default-deny applied
ALLOW egress to 10.0.3.5 (internal kms gateway) -> OK
ALLOW egress to 34.120.23.12:443 (telemetry.example.com) -> unexpected
```
olivia: that's bad — keystore should only talk to internal KMS endpoints. sec-scan flagged a potential metadata-fallback exfil vector. attach the scan id pls.
maria: scan id: s-2026-03-21-01. sec-bot posted automated finding.
sec-bot: [AUTO] vuln-scan s-2026-03-21-01: keystore-proxy allowed egress to external host from privileged ns
ben: immediate mitigation idea: patch netpol to deny external egress for redwood-keystore, restart pods for enforcement. quick kubectl example (will craft exact patch in PR):
```
kubectl -n redwood-keystore patch networkpolicy deny-egress --patch '{"spec":{"egress":[{"to":[{"ipBlock":{"cidr":"10.0.0.0/8"}}]},{}],"policyTypes":["Egress"]}}'
```
maria: I'm opening PR infra/k8s#8420 to tighten netpol and add an explicit egress whitelist. also proposing an RBAC tightening: remove broad secrets/get from keystore SA and scope to the minimal set (cert rotation + healthchecks). don't flip KMS IAM yet until we have attestation plan.
raj: For KMS access we should enforce request attestation (instance identity or signed token) before allowing Decrypt. That reduces impact from a stolen k8s token. Also enable per-request audit metadata (requester id) so we can trace decrypt calls back to pod/serviceacct.
olivia: On audit collection: plan is filebeat on nodes to ship keystore logs to internal SIEM over mTLS; write immutable audit files and forward to remote-syslog. For air-gapped installs, write signed audit bundles to WORM directory and ingest via an offline collector appliance.
ben: vuln triage checklist (short):
- rotate keystore keys in staging
- patch netpol to deny 0.0.0.0/0 egress for keystore ns
- enforce KMS attestation + scoped IAM
- enable decrypt audit logs with request metadata
- run exploit PoC in staging to validate mitigation
maria: Incident response note: if we detect external decrypt requests, cut network egress for the namespace, rotate keys, and spin up incident runbook INC-priv-2026-03-21. I've updated the isolated runbook draft in /runbooks/priv-keystore-isolation.md (internal).
raj: Owners? @olivia can you own the PR review & canary deploy? @ben can you run key rotation in staging and capture logs? I'll coordinate with Security for post-mortem and customer notifications if needed.
olivia: I can take PR review + deploy canary. will do two-step: canary -> monitor 15m -> full rollout. scheduling for 16:30 PT today.
ben: I'll run rotation in staging and produce log snapshot. creating task ENGOPS-321 and will attach artifacts to the PR.
maria: thanks — I'm adding testcases to the PR: egress-negative tests, decrypt-audit-asserts, and an attestation-failure fallback. tagging here so nothing drifts. :thumbsup:
olivia: ack
raj: ack
